section_title: Examples of predicate crimes > Drug trafficking

propositions.proposition: During the sourcing, manufacturing, or distribution stages of drug trafficking, money laundering can occur.
source_quotes: Money laundering can occur during the sourcing, manufacturing, or distribution stages.

propositions.proposition: At the sourcing stage, when the raw material is obtained and refined, criminal organizations utilize various methods to launder money.
source_quotes: Criminal organizations utilize various methods to launder money at the sourcing stage when the raw material is obtained and refined.

propositions.proposition: Payments for chemical precursors and logistics are often made on the basis of fraudulent trade invoices and routed through offshore shell companies, cryptocurrency mixing services, and hawala networks, which allows traffickers to obscure the origins of their funds from the beginning of the supply chain.
source_quotes: Payments for chemical precursors and logistics are often made on the basis of fraudulent trade invoices and routed through offshore shell companies, cryptocurrency mixing services, and hawala networks.
This allows traffickers to obscure the origins of their funds from the beginning of the supply chain.

propositions.proposition: At the manufacturing stage, proceeds are funneled through agribusiness, real estate acquisitions, shell logistics firms, and TBML, which helps traffickers integrate illicit funds into the economy.
source_quotes: At the manufacturing stage, proceeds are funneled through agribusiness, real estate acquisitions, shell logistics firms, and TBML.
These methods help traffickers integrate illicit funds into the economy.

propositions.proposition: Criminal organizations utilize the international trade system to launder proceeds from drug trafficking.
source_quotes: criminal organizations also utilize the international trade system to launder proceeds from drug trafficking.

propositions.proposition: Colombian drug traffickers historically use the Colombian Black Market Peso Exchange (BMPE) to convert US dollars into Colombian pesos, which allows them to settle drug debts or purchase future shipments while obscuring the origins of their funds.
source_quotes: Colombian drug traffickers, for instance, have historically used the Colombian Black Market Peso Exchange (BMPE) to convert US dollars into Colombian pesos.
This system allows traffickers to settle drug debts or purchase future shipments while obscuring the origins of their funds.

propositions.proposition: Once drugs are sold and distributed, traffickers launder the consolidated cash through shell companies to appear legitimate, integrating illicit funds into the financial system.
source_quotes: Once drugs are sold and distributed, traffickers launder the consolidated cash through shell companies to appear legitimate, integrating illicit funds into the financial system.

propositions.proposition: Drug trafficking proceeds are considered 'dirty money' that need to be concealed to avoid detection by law enforcement.
source_quotes: the proceeds are considered 'dirty money' that need to be concealed to avoid detection by law enforcement.

propositions.proposition: Integration methods for drug trafficking money laundering include real estate acquisitions in global cities, luxury asset purchases such as art, gold, yachts, and rare diamonds, and crypto-laundering through exchanges and non-fungible token platforms.
source_quotes: Integration methods include real estate acquisitions in global cities, luxury asset purchases such as art, gold, yachts, and rare diamonds, and crypto-laundering through exchanges and non-fungible token platforms.
